text:
noelle: Quick decision thread  small sweep on docs naming + snippet casing before the canary. Need agreement on three things: prose term for 'variant', canonical backend field name, and SDK snippet casing. Can we lock today? cc @jamie @rachel @sam

jamie: My picks: prose -> 'model variant' (two words). Backend canonical -> model_id. SDKs should show idiomatic names per language and include a 1-line mapping comment.

rachel: +1. Also: mark 'replica' as internal infra only (do not teach publicly). Add a glossary redirect for any pages that currently use it.

sam: Agreed. Conventions table I'll add to the style guide appendix: YAML/configs -> model_variant_id, Python -> model_id, JS -> modelVariantId. And for UI labels use 'Variant' (capitalized).

noelle: Nice. Small voice guidance too: avoid marketing words like 'magical', 'flavor', 'seamless' in API/tutorial docs. Add a short blacklist line to voice section.

docs-bot: lint: detected 7 curl snippets using form-encoded 'model='; recommend switching to JSON body with "model_id". See examples/curl.md lines 8-26.

noelle: I'll batch curl fixes into #701 and casing/snippet fixes into #702 (JS) and #703 (Python). If you take any, drop a note here so we don't overlap.

jamie: Taking #702 (JS). I'll run a grep for occurrences of model_id in JS snippets and replace with modelVariantId, adding comments like `// maps to backend model_id`.

rachel: I'll take #703 and audit Python snippets to ensure they use model_id. Also will add the glossary entry: "model variant: a user-facing model configuration/checkpoint; replica: internal runtime copy used for scaling." Keep it short.

noelle: Example snippet we should standardize across docs (include in PRs):

curl suggestion:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-3-mini","input":"Hello"}'

python snippet:
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(model_id="gpt-3-mini", input="Hi")
print(resp.output)

javascript snippet (JS SDK):
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ modelVariantId: 'gpt-3-mini', input: 'Hi' })
// maps to backend field model_id
console.log(resp.output)

noelle: Also found a stale link in migrate/embeds pointing to /migrate/old-embeds. Will replace with /migrate/embeddings-batch in the link-fix PR.

docs-bot: ci: preview deployed for branch 701 (https://preview.docs.redwood/branches/701) - checks passed

sam: Tiny note: in UI copy use singular "Variant" for labels and "Variants" only in list contexts. I'll add that to the style guide microcopy section.

jamie: I'll leave short PR descriptions explaining why we change casing (language idioms) so reviewers understand mapping.

rachel: After merges, QA should run the snippet-runner to validate examples against preview endpoints. I'll coordinate with QA.

noelle: Plan: merge small PRs by Tuesday EOD, canary Wednesday 09:00 UTC. If you pick a PR, drop the number here. Thanks all  small focused changes so reviews stay fast. :sparkles:
